u0: Initial state: the agent is not at the exit and has not toggled the wall switch. The main objective is to reach the exit; if convenient, first go to the left-wall switch and toggle it to gain the one-time switch reward and move to u1. Reaching the exit directly from here also ends the episode successfully.
u1: Progress state: the wall switch has been toggled at least once, and the agent is not yet at the exit. The remaining objective is to navigate to the exit. Further switch toggles do not change the reward-machine state or add switch reward; box possession or loss is not tracked by this RM.
u2: Terminal success state: the agent has reached the exit and the episode ends. This state may be reached with or without having toggled the switch earlier, since both u0 and u1 can transition here on at_exit. No further objective or action is needed.
